Saturation tests cover required-lane completeness, missing readLog, critic dispositions (verified_family/duplicate/not_verified/unknown/conflict), suspected findings excluded, wave_advance-only persistence of nonzero-new waves, side-effect-free finalize rejection, and REVIEW_INVENTORY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED never manufacturing PASS.
